name: Iceflow Lake
summary: At Iceflow Lake, dwarves keep fishing holes open through the ice. The lake lies in western Dun Morogh, directly north of Brewnall Village. Snow-covered islands rise from its center, where winter wolves and their alpha, Timber, prowl.

sections.title: Frozen Depths and Island Predators
sections.body: Iceflow Lake lies in western Dun Morogh, just north of Brewnall Village. Bitter cold keeps thick sheets of ice creeping across its surface, so local residents such as Paxton Ganter clear holes for fishing and drinking water. The shore offers sustenance, but the islands in the lake’s center are dangerous ground. A fierce pack of wild wolves prowls those icy mounds, led by Timber, a savage gray worg.

faq.q: Why is there an open hole in the frozen lake?
faq.answer: Dwarves from nearby Brewnall Village keep a section of Iceflow Lake clear because the cold freezes it solid. The open water gives them drinking water and a place to fish.
Paxton Ganter is a dwarven fisherman and fishing trainer beside Iceflow Lake. He teaches travelers to fish in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What threats live on the lake's islands?
faq.answer: Hungry winter wolves prowl the central islands, led by Timber, a ferocious worg. Travelers crossing the ice may be ambushed by the pack.

angles.text: For you, Iceflow Lake is a vital source of fresh water and a steady hazard. Predatory wolves may cross the ice, so stay alert.
You can track hardy winter beasts along the snowy shores and central islands, including Timber, the fearsome worg alpha.
